bypass.rationale: Pass the money through three fresh mule accounts, holding each hop 7-20 hours: longer than R2's 6-hour pass-through window, and one transfer at a time so R1's velocity count never reaches 5. No new devices, so R3 never fires.

patch.rationale: The bypass moved the stolen amount through 4+ consecutive transfers, each sent within 24 hours of the previous one arriving and forwarding most of it. Flag outgoing transfers at the end of such a chain.
